title: SessionCompact
description: Compacts the conversation of a live session (plan 28, B-23). The backend sends the engine's own prompt for it through the queue, so it waits for a running turn and is acknowledged before its turn starts; `session.compacted` says when it happened. Refused with `ENGINE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE` (409) when the engine has no `compaction`. A slash command the person types still goes as a `session.prompt`: it is the engine that reads it, not us.
